'''July 2001 Minnesota tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Outpost 2000 on 28 July 2001. [[Garrett Larson]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2741">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-outpost-deadbody-style-7-28-01d2741/ outpost-deadbody-style-7-28-01], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 30 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-outpost-deadbody-style-7-28-01d2741/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Outpost 2000
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 20
* '''Winner:''' [[Garrett Larson]]
